name: Soeur ~Shibarareru Ai, Chiriyuku Ai~
original_name: Soeur ～縛られる愛、散りゆく愛～
source:
Main character is in good relations with his sister and her childhood friend. Emotions for sister eventually overflow into forbidden love...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角与姐姐及她的青梅竹马关系融洽。然而，对姐姐的感情逐渐满溢，最终化为禁忌之恋……

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
